item.title: Congo Ebola Outbreak: How Fear and Mistrust Drive Community Spread
item.description: As the Ebola virus spreads in eastern Congo, health teams struggle to curb fatal delays in seeking medical care and the widespread desire to treat sick relatives at home.

item.title: Tracking China’s Intensifying War of Words Against Japan
item.description: Beijing is running a concerted campaign to paint Japan as an aggressor and resurgent military threat, according to a Times analysis.

item.title: From Failed Businessman to Accused Plotter in the Killing of Haiti’s Leader
item.description: Prosecutors say Christian Sanon was a con man who oversaw a plan to assassinate the country’s president. His defense says he played no part in the plot’s fatal outcome.

item.title: Ukraine Attacks Kerch Bridge Linking Russia to Occupied Crimea
item.description: Destroying the structure, the only one connecting Russia to the occupied Crimean Peninsula, has long been a top objective for Kyiv.

item.title: Nepal Came to COP31 in Dire Need. It’s a Test for the World.
item.description: A deadly glacier collapse left the country with $5 billion in recovery costs. So far, few have stepped up with aid.
